proof_body:
by
  intro A _ _ a s t hs ht
  have hs' : IsUnit (algebraMap ℂ A s - a) := hs
  have ht' : IsUnit (algebraMap ℂ A t - a) := ht
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hs'
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := ht'
  have hrs : resolvent a s = ((u⁻¹ : Aˣ) : A) := by
    simp [resolvent, ← hu]
  have hrt : resolvent a t = ((v⁻¹ : Aˣ) : A) := by
    simp [resolvent, ← hv]
  rw [hrs, hrt]
  have key : (t - s) • (1 : A) = (v : A) - (u : A) := by
    rw [hu, hv, sub_smul, Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]; abel
  have : (t - s) • (((u⁻¹ : Aˣ) : A) * ((v⁻¹ : Aˣ) : A)) = ((u⁻¹ : Aˣ) : A) * ((t - s) • (1 : A)) * ((v⁻¹ : Aˣ) : A) := by
    simp
  rw [this, key, mul_sub, sub_mul]
  simp
target_source: ∀ (A : Type*) [Ring A] [Algebra ℂ A] (a : A) (s t : ℂ), s ∈ resolventSet ℂ a → t ∈ resolventSet ℂ a → resolvent a s - resolvent a t = (t - s) • (resolvent a s * resolvent a t)
